# TrevRPC compressed message golden vectors: ZSTD_MESSAGE and
# ZSTD_STREAM_MESSAGE payloads and the negotiation fields. Runtimes that implement compression consume
# this file in addition to wire-golden-vectors.txt.
#
# The payloads were written by libzstd 1.5.7 at level 1, streams with a 64 KiB
# window. They lock decoding only: other encoders may write different, equally
# valid payloads.
#
# Entry kinds (values are lowercase hex; an empty value means zero bytes):
#   dict.<name>.id           the Dictionary_ID as an unsigned integer in hex
#   dict.<name>.fingerprint  the first 8 bytes of the dictionary's SHA-256
#   dict.<name>.dictionary   the zstd-format dictionary
#   ok.<name>.payload        a ZSTD_MESSAGE payload a receiver holding only
#                            dict.d1 must accept
#   ok.<name>.message        the message it decompresses to
#   bad.<name>.payload       a payload a receiver holding only dict.d1 must
#                            reject as invalid
#   plain.<name>.payload     a ZSTD_MESSAGE payload without a dictionary,
#                            which a receiver accepting ID 0 must accept and
#                            one accepting only dict.d1 must reject
#   plain.<name>.message     the message it decompresses to
#   too_large.<name>.payload a payload declaring more than 4 MiB, which a
#                            receiver with the default max frame size must
#                            reject as too large without decompressing it
#   stream.<name>.<i>.payload
#                            the i-th ZSTD_STREAM_MESSAGE payload of one
#                            direction of a call, which a receiver that
#                            advertised max_window_log 16 and holds dict.d1
#                            decodes, in order, with a fresh context
#   stream.<name>.<i>.message the message payload i decodes to
#   stream_bad.<name>.payload the first ZSTD_STREAM_MESSAGE payload of a
#                            direction, which such a receiver must reject
#                            as invalid
#   stream_too_large.<name>.payload
#                            a first payload declaring more than 4 MiB, which
#                            a receiver with the default max frame size must
#                            reject as too large without decompressing it
#   <name>.payload / .frame  as in wire-golden-vectors.txt
#
# Logical values:
#   ok.small                  a 71-byte message in a single-segment frame
#   ok.raw_block              an incompressible 40-byte message in a raw block
#   ok.empty                  an empty message
#   ok.checksum               ok.small's message with a content checksum
#   ok.multi_segment          a 1500-byte message in a multi-segment frame
#                             (window descriptor, 2-byte content size)
#   bad.unknown_dictionary    compressed with dictionary 300 (not held)
#   bad.no_dictionary_id      ok.small without its Dictionary_ID: compressed
#                             with dict.d1, so decompressing it without a
#                             dictionary fails even where ID 0 is accepted
#   bad.no_content_size       no Frame_Content_Size
#   bad.trailing_bytes        ok.small followed by one zero byte
#   bad.trailing_frame        ok.small followed by ok.empty
#   bad.magic_number          a standard frame, with the Magic_Number
#   bad.checksum              ok.checksum with a wrong checksum
#   bad.truncated             ok.small without its last two bytes
#   bad.content_size_mismatch ok.small declaring one byte less than it holds
#   plain.records             a 315-byte JSON record without a dictionary
#                             (single segment, 2-byte content size)
#   too_large.zeros           4 MiB + 1 zero bytes
#   zstd_message.small        a ZSTD_MESSAGE frame carrying ok.small
#   request.dictionaries      RpcRequest{method:"/svc/m", accept_dictionaries:[1, 300]
#                             (packed), dictionary_query:[{id:1, fingerprint:dict.d1}]}
#   headers.dictionaries      RpcHeaders{dictionaries:[{id:1, fingerprint:dict.d1}]}
#   request.plain             RpcRequest{method:"/svc/m", accept_dictionaries:[0]
#                             (packed), dictionary_query:[{}]}: compression
#                             without a dictionary, offered and queried
#   headers.plain             RpcHeaders{dictionaries:[{}]}: the answer
#   stream.plain              four messages in one 64 KiB-window stream without
#                             a dictionary: three that compress against each
#                             other, then a 40-byte incompressible one in a
#                             raw block
#   stream.seeded             the first three, in a stream seeded with dict.d1
#   stream.reset              two messages; the first chunk ends the frame, so
#                             the second starts a new one
#   stream.empty              a message, then an empty one (an empty chunk)
#   stream_bad.window_too_large   a 128 KiB window
#   stream_bad.checksum_flag      Content_Checksum_flag set
#   stream_bad.content_size       a single-segment frame with Frame_Content_Size
#   stream_bad.magic_number       a standard frame, with the Magic_Number
#   stream_bad.unknown_dictionary stream.seeded.0 naming dictionary 2 (not held)
#   stream_bad.size_mismatch      stream.plain.0 declaring one byte less
#   stream_bad.truncated          stream.plain.0 without its last byte
#   stream_bad.trailing_bytes     stream.plain.0 followed by one zero byte, the
#                                 start of a block that never arrives
#   stream_bad.missing_frame_header stream.plain.1 as a direction's first payload
#   stream_too_large.zeros    4 MiB + 1 zero bytes
#   zstd_stream_message.first a ZSTD_STREAM_MESSAGE frame carrying stream.plain.0
#   request.stream_compression RpcRequest{method:"/svc/m",
#                             stream_compression:{max_window_log:16}}
#   headers.stream_compression RpcHeaders{stream_compression:{max_window_log:16}}
#   request.optimistic_stream_compression RpcRequest{method:"/svc/m",
#                             stream_compression:{max_window_log:16, optimistic:true}}
#   status.refused_stream_compression RpcStatus{code:8 (ResourceExhausted),
#                             refused_stream_compression:true}
